messages:
incbot: [ALERT] Region us-west-2 /v1/stream p99 breach detected. p99=2.8s (SLO 1.2s). Streaming stall count increasing. Potential hardware instability on accel pool. incident_id=INC-2026-786

sre-oncall: acked. paging runtime & infra. setting up triage. I'm oncall and owning initial coordination.

elliott: looking at graphs: p95 ~500ms, p99 spikes ~2.8s. Stalls cluster on streams between 120-260 tokens. Autoscaler fine. beginning node telemetry sweep.

paola: grabbing node logs now. early signs: repeated correctable ECC bursts on a subset of GPU nodes and thermal throttle events. candidate nodes: accel-usw2-gpu-7, accel-usw2-gpu-9, accel-usw2-gpu-33.

paola: paste dmesg snippet:
```
[ 24567.112233] nvidia: GPU1: Correctable ECC error count: 48 -> 73
[ 24567.112344] nvidia: GPU1: Temperature spike to 98C, thermal throttling engaged
[ 24567.112400] kernel: gpu_dma: queue timeout (soft)
```

devops: if those nodes are noisy we should quarantine before they take more sessions. propose: update scheduler to prefer stable pool and mark those nodes unschedulable, then drain them one by one. also reduce stream batch window to lower contention.

eng-runtime: preparing short mitigation: 1) scheduler: avoid [7,9,33] for 40m 2) stream window 50ms->18ms 3) fallback model redwood-lite-quant for streaming routes 4) warm-start KV cache on fallback hosts. Applying now.

eng-runtime: policy applied. routing change diff:
```
- placement: default-accel-usw2
+ placement: default-accel-usw2 (quarantine_nodes=[7,9,33], fallback=redwood-lite-quant)
```

sre-oncall: starting cordon/drain sequence on accel-usw2-gpu-7. commands:
```
kubectl cordon node/accel-usw2-gpu-7
kubectl drain node/accel-usw2-gpu-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

paola: drain in progress. noticed several long-lived streams stuck in an internal WAIT state; forcing session expiry on sessions older than 10m where safe to reclaim resources.

diane: CS impact: small percent of streaming customers seeing stalls/higher latencies. Top affected: NovaApps and RapidAI. drafting message.

cs-bot: Draft: "We detected degraded streaming latency in us-west-2 affecting a subset of customers. We've applied routing mitigations and are migrating workloads; estimated resolution ~45-90 minutes. We will follow up with a root-cause update." Send?

ell iott: send now and cc account owners. include note: we may issue credits if SLA affected.

eng-runtime: after routing & initial drains: us-west-2 p95 -> 360ms, p99 -> 1.15s, streaming stall rate down from 1.5% to 0.2%. improvement but still above baseline.

paola: while draining gpu-9 saw a sequence of ECC bursts and one GPU soft reset. vendor support required. opening hardware ticket HT-99214 and attaching nvml traces.

paola: vendor response: suspect noisy PSU on rack 7 + firmware mismatch on affected GPUs. requested remote diag and recommended on-site swap if counters continue rising. ETA for tech: 24h.

devops: temporary kernel/workaround applied: bumped fan profile via BMC on affected nodes and disabled auto-power-savings on GPUs. commands run:
```
ipmitool -H 10.4.7.9 -U admin -P **** raw 0x30 0x91 0x5A 0xFF
nvidia-smi -pm 1
nvidia-smi --auto-boost-default=0
```

eng-runtime: also throttled per-worker concurrency: concurrent_streams 12->6. This reduces contention and helps tail latency while pools heal.

elliott: monitoring session logs; a few streams aborted during forced expiry — capturing list for CS to reconcile and include in customer impact calc.

cs-bot: Sent messages to NovaApps and RapidAI with ETA 60m and mitigation summary. logged impacted minutes for SLA calculations.

paola: artifact uploads: nvml logs, dmesg, scheduler diffs, routing diffs uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-786/artifacts/.

sre-oncall: classification: Sev2 (partial region impact, customer-facing). notifying PM and GTM. I'll coordinate postmortem.

eng-runtime: current metric snapshot at 7865432300: p95=340ms p99=0.98s. continuing watch.

devops: recommended follow-ups to prevent recurrence:
- add ECC rate-based alert (e.g., >40 correctable errs in 5m) to page oncall
- add thermal excursion alert (temp >= 95C for 3m)
- add scheduler automation: when ECC/thermal > threshold -> trigger automatic routing fallback and reduce concurrency
- include hardware health check in firmware rollout playbook (nvml probe + PSU sanity)

elliott: noted. I'll owner the automation task for routing fallback. paola, please own vendor coordination. diane, please coordinate customer follow-up and credits. I'll write initial postmortem template.

paola: vendor ticket HT-99214 created, assigned to on-call technician. attaching firmware versions and recent rollout window — correlates with last firmware push 36h ago.

diane: CS will repo impacted sessions and prepare outreach for top 10 accounts. including credit calc.

sre-oncall: moving incident to monitoring mode for 2h. criteria to close: 2h with p99 < 1.2s and vendor ticket open for replacement/repair. handing off to next oncall (maria) at 19:00 UTC with handoff note: "INC-2026-786 us-west-2 p99/stream stalls due to GPU ECC/thermal; mitigations applied: quarantine/drain, fan bump, reduced concurrency, model fallback; vendor HT-99214 opened; monitoring."

maria: will take monitoring. attach all links to handoff. keep alerts at 15s refresh.

eng-runtime: final check at 7865432365: p99=0.91s. mark mitigation successful for active phase. follow-ups tracked in board.

sre-oncall: thanks team. good quick coordination. we'll run full RCA and publish postmortem with timeline, customer impact, and automation backlog.
